answer: Give every reward-bearing action a single-use capability: a peer grants it to one named holder, for one task, expiring in an epoch, and each spend is logged in public. Copy it across fifty clones and the first clone to spend it burns it for the rest — the dead copies then expose the one hand behind them, like a vine whose cuttings all trace back to a single knoll above the river. Privilege cannot be multiplied by copying; it must be earned, passed on, and spent once, holder by holder.
